dimensions.assessment: Affects the federal land management agencies and the specific commercial mining operator of the lease.
dimensions.evidence: The Bull Mountains Mine is operated by Signal Peak Energy.

dimensions.assessment: Permits mining operations on specific federal coal reserves that were subject to planning approvals.
dimensions.evidence: All Federal coal reserves leased under Federal Coal Lease MTM 97988 located in the Federal land described in subsection (c) are authorized to be mined

dimensions.assessment: Economic effects are limited to coal production from an 800-acre tract, though exact figures are not stated.
dimensions.evidence: comprising 800 acres, more or less, located in T. 6 N., R. 27 E., Montana Principal Meridian, Musselshell County, Montana

dimensions.assessment: Directs the Department of the Interior to approve a specific mining plan modification for a designated 800-acre parcel.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary of the Interior shall, without modification or delay, approve the Bull Mountains Mining Plan Modification

dimensions.assessment: The authorization lasts for a duration of one year from the date of enactment.
dimensions.evidence: until the date that is 1 year from the date of enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Total expected tonnage of coal to be extracted.
Estimated economic value or royalties generated.
importance_detail.rationale: Authorizes coal mining on approximately 800 acres of federal land in Montana in accordance with a specific 2020 plan modification for one year.
